summary: Large PIM for Groups policy changes are always held for approval, and group policy updates are much faster.

fixes.title: Safety brake covers group policies
fixes.text: Large or weakening PIM for Groups policy changes are now always held for approval, exactly like Entra role and Azure resource policies.

fixes.title: Faster group policy updates
fixes.text: Group policy updates send only what changed, so large policy alignments run many times faster.

fixes.title: Governance opens quickly
fixes.text: The drift check runs only when you click Check for drift (slow), so opening Governance no longer slows the Manager.
